name: Manchester Open 2017

venue.name: [Oasis Academy MediaCityUK] (http://www.oasisacademymediacityuk.org)
venue.address: King William Street, Salford, Greater Manchester, M50 3UQ

information: You must pay the entry fee online via the button on the [UKCA site](http://www.ukca.org/competitions/upcoming-competitions/manchester-open-2017/registration) before your registration is approved. This fee is non-refundable, as it represents a commitment to attending the competition. There is a competitor limit of 150. Registration will close at midnight on Sunday 1st January.
